caption: The chapter's worked example, recomputed step by step: four T gates square twice to Z, and H Z H comes out as exactly X with global phase +1. Nothing is approximate here — the finite set {H, T, CNOT} builds X exactly.

spec.title: H T T T T H gives X

nodes.label: H T T T T H

spec.aria: A downward five-step flow: the gate string H T T T T H, then T to the fourth equals Z, then H Z H, then X with entries 0, 1, 1, 0, then global phase plus one.
